{{Top|leg}}
An '''SOS''' was a form of [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. Days after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] received such a distress message from [[Wilek Nereus]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], pleading for assistance from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to repel an [[Bakura Incident|invasion]] from the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]].
